reason: Modified HAL_UART_IRQHandler to remove hardware dependencies while preserving interrupt handling functionality. The original function reads hardware registers (SR, CR1, CR3) and checks various flags, which causes issues in emulation without real hardware. The modified version simulates UART interrupt handling by reading data from stdin (using HAL_BE_In) for receive operations and completing transfers for transmit operations. This preserves the state machine and callback functionality while avoiding infinite loops or blocking behavior.
